:::{#rem-indicator-vector-names}
#### Other names for indicator vectors

Indicator vectors are also called *standard basis vectors*,
or *unit vectors*.
For $p = 3$, they are
$\vecf{e}_1 = (1, 0, 0)$, $\vecf{e}_2 = (0, 1, 0)$, and $\vecf{e}_3 = (0, 0, 1)$.
Every vector of length $3$ is a linear combination of them;
for example,
$(2, -1, 5) = 2\vecf{e}_1 - 1\vecf{e}_2 + 5\vecf{e}_3$.

:::
